title: Bruno and His School
text:
Hi, my name is Bruno. I am ten years old. I study at a small school. My favorite subject is music. We sing songs every Tuesday.

My teacher is Mrs. Silva. She teaches math and English. Math is hard for me, but I like it. After class, I practice numbers with my mom.

questions.text: What subjects does Mrs. Silva teach?
How does Bruno probably feel about math?
options: He finds it difficult but still likes it
He hates it and never studies
He does not think about it

questions.text: Why does Bruno practice numbers with his mom?
options: He wants to get better at math
He is going on a trip

not easy to do or understand
to do something again and again to get better

paragraph_translations: Oi, meu nome é Bruno. Eu tenho dez anos. Eu estudo em uma escola pequena. Minha matéria favorita é música. Cantamos canções toda terça-feira.
Minha professora é a senhora Silva. Ela ensina matemática e inglês. Matemática é difícil para mim, mas eu gosto. Depois da aula, eu pratico números com a minha mãe.
